q2_gaps: respect/dimension PP on a copular adjective with no magnitude ("is very big in size") — Measure needs a number+unit, Degree's level slot takes the intensifier (already used by "very"), and forKind takes a comparison class, so no licensed form names the dimension
notes: Matches the "Alice is very tall" pattern exactly — positive (Member x big) kept alongside (Degree x big very). "in size" is unrepresented, the same gap as the plain-adjective variant.
